annotations.title: Keep a comparison as a dataset

description: Save a comparison as a private draft dataset in the signed-in account: tools, required capabilities, the default scenario. Returns the dataset id, configVersion and a preview with coverage. Nothing is public until atlas_dataset_publish. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.

productIds.description: Atlas domains, e.g. "otter.ai"; resolve names with atlas_search first.

currency.description: ISO code; plans in other currencies are not converted. Default USD.

longestRecording.description: Longest single recording in minutes, when per-recording caps matter.

volume.description: Minutes of audio transcribed per month across the team.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string per intended change (8-128 chars). A retry with the same key and body returns the first answer.

name: atlas_dataset_create
